title: Effectiveness of Community Volunteer Scheme in Reducing Littering
what_it_is: Effectiveness of Community Volunteer Scheme in Reducing Littering

sections.label: Community Volunteer programme launch
sections.summary: NEA launched the Community Volunteer programme in 2013 to foster greater ownership of the environment as part of tackling littering.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: As part of our efforts to tackle littering, the National Environment Agency (NEA) launched the Community Volunteer (CV) programme in 2013 to foster greater ownership of the environment.

sections.label: Community Volunteers and littering enforcement
sections.summary: CVs encourage the public to bin litter, over 330 joined, they engaged over 3,700 litterbugs, and NEA issued over 31,000 littering tickets in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: CVs help to strengthen the social norm of keeping the environment clean by encouraging fellow members of the public to bin their litter.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: I am heartened that more than 330 individuals from all walks of life have come on board the CV programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Our CVs have engaged more than 3,700 litter bugs, most of whom were cooperative when asked to pick up their litter.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: In 2016, NEA issued more than 31,000 tickets for littering offences, 17 of which were to uncooperative litterbugs that our CVs had encountered and whose particulars had been forwarded to NEA for further action.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Many of the tickets issued for littering from vehicles, for example, arise from reports from civic-minded members of the public.

sections.label: Enforcement officer numbers and volunteers
sections.summary: The speaker does not have the exact number of enforcement officers, says numbers have increased over the years with limits, and cites CVs and Keep Singapore Clean volunteers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to the first question about the number of environment officers enforcing, I do not have the exact number.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Whether we will increase the number of enforcement officers, I think we have, over the years, increased the number of enforcement officers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But obviously, there is a limit as to the number that we can increase.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have also engaged the help of our CVs, not just those who are signed up as CVs, but also volunteers under our "Keep Singapore Clean" programme and so on, to help encourage as well as build up the community's sense of ownership for the environment and to do the right thing.
